Delhi MCD's new property tax drive: Drones to map buildings and spot discrepancies

2026-09-24 Anjali Thakur (Mint) Delhi MCD, drone survey, property tax, GIS, LiDAR, 3D modelling, geo-tagging, AI, property assessment, digital mapping
Read the source article

Quick summary

Delhi's Municipal Corporation has launched a pilot drone survey in two wards using GIS, LiDAR, AI, and 3D modelling to identify unassessed and under-assessed properties, building a more accurate digital property database and reducing reliance on manual inspections.

Key takeaways

  • MCD launched a pilot drone survey in Rohini F Ward and Gharoli Ward as the first phase of a technology-driven property assessment approach
  • The survey combines drone imagery with GIS, LiDAR-based mapping, geo-tagging, AI, and 3D digital modelling
  • The system identifies incorrectly mapped records, duplicate entries, and additional floors not in existing records
  • Ward- and zone-level dashboards will let officials monitor discrepancies, issue notices, and track property tax arrears
  • The GIS-based system supports faster grievance redressal through digital access to property information
  • The initiative aims to bring greater transparency while reducing physical interaction with civic officials
